description: Asian Development Bank financing (loans, grants, technical assistance) from ADB's official IATI data via d-portal.org: IATI activity id, ADB project number and link, title, recipient country, status, start/end dates, committed and disbursed USD, description. Filter by country (ISO2) and title words; newest start first. Open data, no key. Related tools on this server, for a different need: finance_bank_of_england_iadb when you need Bank of England official daily statistics for one series; finance_bcb_brazil_central_bank when you need Brazil Central Bank SGS time series: the latest N values. Price: $0.002 in USDC per successful call, paid with x402 (Base, Solana or Arc); failed calls are not charged.

country.description: Recipient country ISO 3166 alpha-2 code, e.g. PK, IN, PH, BD, VN (optional)

q.description: Word or phrase contained in the project title, e.g. solar (optional, max 60 characters)

name: finance_asian_dev_bank_data
title: Asian Development Bank financing from ADB's official IATI
